title: Inner Demons
description: A reality show crew descends upon the home of a teenager struggling with drug addiction and uncover instead a terrifying case of demonic possession.

title: The Devil's Doorway
description: When two priests investigate a miracle in an Irish home for unwed mothers in 1960, they discover that one of the residents is possessed by the devil.

title: The Cleansing Hour
description: Two entrepreneurs stage elaborate fake exorcisms until one of their girlfriends becomes possessed by a demon.

title: Sissy
description: High school best friends Cecilia and Emma run into each other after a decade, and Emma invites Cecilia on a weekend away. Stuck in a remote cabin with her high school bully, Cecilia quickly develops a taste for revenge.

title: All Hallows' Eve
description: A babysitter finds a tape with three tales of terror on it, all linked to a murderous clown.

title: All Hallows' Eve 2
description: A woman finds a VHS tape that shows a series of gruesome tales.

title: Host
description: Six friends accidentally invite the attention of a demonic presence during an online séance and begin noticing strange occurrences in their homes.

title: Found Footage 3D
description: A film crew making a found footage horror movie find themselves in a horror movie when an evil entity escapes into their footage.

title: The Found Footage Phenomenon
description: Chartering the origins, impact, and legacy of the found footage subgenre. Filmmakers look at precisely what has made these films so popular and expose the sometimes sophisticated social and cultural nuances that make the films tick.

title: Can't Take It Back
description: Two teenage girls bring a dark curse upon themselves when they leave hateful comments on a dead classmate's Facebook page.

title: Shook
description: When Mia, a social media star, becomes the target of an online terror campaign, she has to solve a series of games to prevent people she cares about from getting murdered.

title: Crowsnest
description: Police discover video footage of nomadic cannibals attacking a group of vacationing friends.

title: Confessional
description: After two mysterious deaths at a college on the same night, seven students receive invitations to reveal what they know about the deceased inside a confessional booth hidden on campus.
